Marta: Quick noteour SDKs collapse everything into a single `APIError`. Customers can't reliably decide: should they retry, prompt for reauth, or surface an instruction to the end user?

Sam: Agree. Proposal: small typed surface + a few stable fields. Types: AuthError, RateLimitError, ValidationError, SafetyError, TransientError. Fields: `code` (machine id), `message` (friendly), `retryable` (bool), `retry_after` (secs, optional), `hint` (short user-facing guidance), `internal_error_id` (support lookup).

Ryan: We already have similar in python, but JS and Go are inconsistent. For JS: use `err.name` and `err.code` + explicit `retryable`. For Go, prefer exported error types/interfaces so callers can type-switch instead of parsing strings.

Tasha: Sample app suggestion: include a tiny flow demonstrating each case (auth CTA, rate-limit countdown, field highlighting for validation). UX copy should come from a shared copy file so SDKs can reference consistent phrasing.

Marta: Two principles: 1) never leak raw stack traces to end users, only `internal_error_id`; 2) keep envelope fields stable (clients should not rely on parsing freeform `message`).

Sam: Also preserve a `signal` token for Console grouping (`quota_exceeded`, `auth_expired`, `model_rejected`). That helps monitoring and automatic suggestions in the Console.

Ryan: I'll draft a tiny RFC with a canonical JSON envelope and a sample js-sdk change. Example envelope (for clarity): 

```json
{"type":"error","error":{"name":"RateLimitError","code":"rate_limit","message":"Too many requests","retryable":true,"retry_after":10,"hint":"please wait before retrying","internal_error_id":"abc-123","signal":"quota_exceeded"}}
```

Tasha: I'll produce the sampleapp components and unit tests to validate SDK parity. ETA Thu EOD.

devex-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-442: "consumer-sdk typed errors + hints + sampleapp" and linked this thread.

Marta: Thanks team. Let's meet tomorrow to align exact `hint` phrasing and which SDKs get the initial patches. @Ryan @Tasha please add PR links in the ticket when ready. :thumbsup:
